description: Amazon Ads: ads Api/v1/retrieve/reports API. Uses your Nexscope Amazon Ads connection. Credentials remain on the server. Mutations require preview and confirmation.

body.description: JSON string; account query can be `{}`, report creation/polling see dedicated reference respectively.

confirmationToken.description: For mutations, first preview without a token, then confirm using the returned single-use token.

connectionId.description: An Amazon Ads connection owned by the authenticated Nexscope user.

maxAttempts.description: 1–120, default waiting window of approximately 10 minutes.

method.description: The three stages of Ads v1 are all `POST`.

pollInterval.description: 5–300 seconds; official recommendation is to poll every minute.

reportId.description: After passing in, account mapping and creation will be skipped, and existing reports will only be polled.
